example.title: Island Way bridge to the harbour island
example.place: Dana Point Harbor, Dana Point, Orange County, CA

brief: The low road bridge to the harbour island (1971): a short multi-span concrete slab bridge on pile bents over the channel between the two marina basins, with a pipe rail, sidewalks and lamp posts, palms on the island beyond. One photo (in haze, from the bluff). Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
